detail: 25/29 gaps struck; 3 awaiting your word (hook registration, 2 merges, preview-deploy choice) + gemma CUDA fail re-diagnosed
text:
You're right — gap-class work outranks everything (standing ruling). Let me read the board and see where the 30-gap mission actually stands before anything else moves.

The gate wants orientation reads first — doing that, then back to the board.

Yes — that's still exactly the standing state, and nothing has jumped the line. GAP-PRIORITY-HOLD is set on disk (2026-07-03, "the gap queue IS the work"), product missions are mechanically held, and the big project is gated behind gap-list-dry per your own condition in QUEUE.md: *"let me know once all of the Gap fixes are done so that we can discuss the big project that the gate unlocked."*

One count correction from substrate, not memory: **the real total is 29, not 30** — STATE.md's scoreboard (corrected 2026-07-04, after you flagged it) records that "30" was a carried-forward conversational number never derivable from any file. It's 4 top-level system gaps + 25 verified hunt gaps.

**Score: 25/29 struck.** The last 4 — and three of them are waiting on your word, not on work:

1. **Lane-exclusion hook (last hunt item)** — built and tested 9/9 at `~/.claude/hooks/lane-exclusion-gate.mjs`; the one-line registration in settings.json was classifier-blocked. Needs your approval to register it.
2. **#8 repo strands** — fully diagnosed; two clean merges to main need your explicit word "merge": `feat/crown-legal-full-text-2026-06-23` and `feat/lighthouse-post-indexes-2026-06-23` (zero conflicts pre-verified via merge-tree; the crown-legal feature is confirmed completely absent from production).
3. **#7 board-truth** — the bulk passes landed; the remaining 17-mission pile needs a mission-text fix that embeds `wrangler pages deploy --branch=preview` steps, which the classifier treats as deploy-class. Your call: authorize preview-branch deploys specifically, or I build one shared preview-deploy helper you authorize once.
4. **#10 gemma CUDA — mine, and honestly not closed.** I verified the census live this session: gemma crashed again **today 12:43Z** (`HTTP_500 ... CUDA error: an illegal memory access`) under the full ARM-1 mitigation covering both pathways. The 24h-clean bar keeps failing; the gap's own confirmation rule points at demoting gemma off vision-verdict, which is my next beat's work — I'll read the playbook's confirmation rule and act on it rather than keep waiting on a census that keeps failing.

Also done this beat: the daemon was dead ~49 hours (board frozen since 07-05); restarted per the sweep's mechanical action — `daemon UP (PID 34252, singleton)` 14:36Z, with the gap hold still governing what it may fire.

Bottom line: gaps first, unchanged. If you give the word on items 1–3 (hook registration, the two merges, preview-deploy), the list goes dry except for gemma, and the big-project discussion opens on that one outcome push.
